preconditions.description: The integer k must be between 1 and 18 inclusive.
The length of the initial string s must be exactly 2^k - 1 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'0', '1', '?'} for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the initial string s must be either '0', '1', or '?'.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(p) <= (2 ** int(k)) - 1 for p, c in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query position p must be between 1 and 2^k - 1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'0', '1', '?'} for p, c in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query character c must be either '0', '1', or '?'.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(result), int) for result in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output must be an integer representing the number of possible winners.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(result) <= 2 ** int(k) for result in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output must be between 0 and 2^k inclusive, representing the number of possible winners.
The number of outputs must exactly match the number of queries q.
The number of outputs must exactly match the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(result) <= 2 ** int(k) for result in outputs)
postconditions.description: The number of possible winners for each query must be a valid count of teams (0 to 2^k).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(result) <= 2 ** int(k) for result in outputs)
postconditions.description: The output for each query must be a non-negative integer.
